641:t_006:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we come, $$サイデリアル$$!」

641:t_006:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We won't let you stop us! We're setting out into the galaxy to protect Earth... to protect everyone!」

641:t_007:0.en:
$$メール$$
「We did it! A flawless victory!」

641:t_007:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't think something like that can stop us now!」

641:t_007:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't let your guard down. I doubt their attack ends here.」

641:t_008:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

641:t_008:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You had to open your big mouth, $$ランド$$! Now we've got something nasty on our hands!」

641:t_009:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「That is correct, human. Whatever the likes of you may do, it means nothing before the war between gods and demons.」

641:t_010:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「But you have opened a forbidden door.」

641:t_010:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That has provoked their wrath.」

641:t_011:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Are seeking to advance from evolution to $$シンカ$$.」

641:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「There you are, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$!」

641:t_012:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I commend you, Wingless. You have gone beyond what they anticipated.」

641:t_013:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The time has come for you to learn that answer, too.」

641:t_013:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did $$ハーデス$$, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and the others follow you here!?」

641:t_013:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now you will learn the meaning of the fundamental calamity.」

641:t_013:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Doesn't that mean $$サイデリアル$$...!?」

641:t_013:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ are merely their servants.」

641:t_013:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「They are the ones who fancy themselves rulers of this universe...!」

641:t_013:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「The victors in the war of the gods...!」

641:t_013:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Those who wield $$オリジン・ロー$$ and watch over the state of every world...!」

641:t_013:11.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「They stand at the pinnacle of evolution...」

641:t_013:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「And arrogantly refuse to let others attain $$シンカ$$...!」

641:t_013:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And they are our great enemies, who sealed the $$堕天翅$$s in the gap between dimensions 120 million years ago...!」

641:t_014:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you have come as well, inferior gods.」

641:t_014:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You really do love having fun, too, don't you?」

641:t_014:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right, $n. It's the $$ティティ$$ you know, $n.」

641:t_014:6.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$... is supposed to be dead! We saw her body!」

641:t_014:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahaha! Humans really can't understand, can they!?」

641:t_014:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are $$御使い$$s... eternal beings who have already transcended death...」

641:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$御使い$$s...! $$アイム#pilot$$ used that word, too...!」

641:t_014:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... He, too, approached the truth and learned of our existence.」

641:t_014:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But he was so weak, he got killed before he could reach it.」

641:t_014:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are wielders of God's power... Our name is $$御使い$$s...」

641:t_014:14.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Fear me... My name is $$怒りのドクトリン$$.」

641:t_014:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I am $$楽しみのテンプティ$$.」

641:t_014:16.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We serve the Supreme God, and are the fathers and elder brothers of all parallel worlds...」

641:t_014:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In other words, we stand at the pinnacle of all living things... No, of all existence.」

641:t_014:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I feel such overwhelming pressure...!」

641:t_014:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's the same...! As when we first encountered the black $$アンゲロイ$$ and that crystal monster!」

641:t_014:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is correct, foolish Earth species. Our existence, engraved in your genetic information, makes you feel it.」

641:t_014:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ever since humanity landed on the moon and $$クロノ$$ was born, all humans have been like children to $$テンプティ$$ and the others.」

641:t_014:25.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You're just like the $$プロトカルチャー$$, who uplifted humanity's intelligence!」

641:t_014:26.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「They, too, were humans who violated the taboo.」

641:t_014:27.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So we had them destroyed. We brought in a different species from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$, one that sought $$スピリチア$$.」

641:t_014:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you talking about the $$プロトデビルン$$!?」

641:t_014:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「These bastards caused the $$プロトカルチャー$$'s destruction...!」

641:t_014:32.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the $$アンチスパイラル$$ feared... The despair waiting beyond evolution...」

641:t_014:34.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル$$... They were a wise race.」

641:t_014:35.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「They sealed away their own evolution, and even suppressed other humans trying to evolve for us.」
